content:
incident-bot: Detected spike in streaming connection errors in ap-northeast-1 and elevated CPU on push-worker pods (error-rate +420% over baseline). Paging oncall.

robert_oncall: Acknowledge. grabbing logs and current dashboard. any customer-facing impact?

mike_sre: Seeing many stalled SSE clients holding sockets. KV cache growth + OOM kills on a few push-workers. Suspect a combination of client retry storms + slow/gap GC on a new kernel build.

lisa_prod: We have 3 paying customers in APAC with heavy realtime features; support already triaged a few inbound tickets saying responses are hanging. Need mitigation plan now.

sara_eng: Proposal: temporarily turn off streaming responses for ap-northeast-1 and route requests to the non-streaming fallback (chunked polling). That should reduce long-lived sockets and free workers. Can do a region-scoped featureflip. Impact: slight latency increase for large responses and increased token cost.

robert_oncall: Agreed. Do it as a soft disable first (no global rollback). Please annotate and send status page update template.

mike_sre: Command I'll run: `./infra/feature-toggle --region ap-northeast-1 --feature push_streaming --set disabled --note "incident 1729999999 - soft-disable streaming"`

deploy-bot: Received request from mike_sre to toggle feature `push_streaming` -> `disabled` for region `ap-northeast-1`. Starting rollout to routing plane (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

deploy-bot: Rollout step 1 complete (10%). No regressions after 60s.

support_julia: Drafting status message to customers in ap-northeast-1. Will include workaround (retry with polling param) and say we're investigating.

deploy-bot: Rollout step 2 complete (50%).

robert_oncall: Observing immediate drop in long-lived socket count ~68% and push-worker CPU trending down. Errors per second dropping. Good so far.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete (100%). `push_streaming` disabled in ap-northeast-1.

lisa_prod: Good. Julia please send this to affected accounts and post a short blurb on status.redwood.ai:
`We are temporarily disabling streaming responses in ap-northeast-1 to stabilize throughput for realtime features. Some applications may see longer response completion times. We are working to bring streaming back once metrics are stable. - Redwood Inference`

support_julia: Sent to customers and posted status. Included link to best-practices for polling fallback and increased retry jitter.

mike_sre: Post-mitigation plan: 1) capture heap/conn profiles from affected pods 2) roll kernel rollback candidate to a canary group 3) add connection throttling to ingress controller to prevent retry storms 4) implement graceful SSE backpressure in runtime.

robert_oncall: Adding to incident ticket. Assign to eng-runtime (sara) for follow-up and to infra for ingress rate-limiter. We will keep this incident open and will only re-enable streaming when 30m of stable metrics and no OOM kills.

sara_eng: On it. I'll start the profiler collection and open an internal PR for graceful backpressure.

robert_oncall: Thanks all — monitoring. If metrics re-stabilize, we'll coordinate a controlled canary re-enable with prod & support. :white_check_mark:
